# MathBeast

**An LLM that can't lie about maths. Problems are generated by code, answers are
verified by code, and the model only explains.**

> The real guarantee, stated narrowly: it cannot lie about *the answer*, and every
> method claim in its explanation is machine-checked against verified steps.

Status: under construction. Syllabus pack #1 is Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics **0580**.

See [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) for the architecture and
[docs/authoring-skills.md](docs/authoring-skills.md) for the skill format.

## Install

```bash
pip install mathbeast
```

Optional, for explanation mode only — the engine never needs an LLM:

```bash
pip install mathbeast[narrate]   # narrate via a local Ollama server
```
